findings.title: Researcher Reveals How Logic Bugs Alone Cracked Microsoft Edge in $175,000 Pwn2Own Win
findings.summary_md: Orange Tsai of DEVCORE published the full exploit method on October 28, describing how four logic bugs chained into a sandbox escape without memory corruption. The article confirms the $175,000 Pwn2Own Berlin 2026 award and notes the chain relied on universal XSS and navigation-handling weaknesses in Edge.

findings.title: Microsoft Edge Security Updates - Release Notes (CVE-2026-45494, CVE-2026-45492)
findings.summary_md: Microsoft released security updates on October 27 referencing CVE-2026-45494 (CVSS 5.0, navigation-handling weakness allowing cross-origin script injection reported by Orange Tsai) and CVE-2026-45492. These entries confirm vendor acknowledgment and patching of the underlying logic flaws before the public analysis appeared.
